result:
Perfect! The tests all pass. I've implemented `Invoice.subtotal()` to return the sum of all line items' amounts (in paise). The implementation sums the result of calling `amount()` on each item in the invoice.

**All 10 tests pass**, including the specific `test_subtotal` test which verifies that an invoice with two line items (2×1500 paise and 1×9900 paise) correctly returns 12900 paise.
